messages.subject: Indigo — EP clarity objection on the coupler patent
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya — Birchall have flagged the EP examiner's Article 84 clarity objection on claim 1 of the coupler family as a key finding. To keep it 'low/medium', can you confirm your attorneys have filed (or will file before completion) a response? We'll want a specific IP-prosecution warranty and a condition that the response is in.

James
